items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: and Paul Whiteman had all this big band, about 45 pieces.

ctx.x: So I was thinking of the easy way out and if I had the money, I really would have been a C Melody player, too, and Frankie was a great C Melody player. Everybody dug him, you know. He was a big name. And I met him -- now I got to tell you this. I met him -- must have been about 1926 or '27 -- they played the automobile billing and Alfonso Trent, they had them to play first and Paul Whiteman had all this big band, about 45 pieces.
